result.title: FormaFin: Verifiable Financial Analysis with Solver-Guided Reinforcement Learning
result.summary: Formally verifying financial analyses generated by large language models (LLMs) remains challenging as financial rules are largely expressed in natural language and rarely have corresponding formal specifications. Training language models to formalize these rules is hindered by the scarcity of labeled data and reliable training signals, while confidential financial data favor small models that run locally. We introduce FormaFin, a framework that trains small open language models to translate financial rules into reusable SMT formulas. FormaFin integrates teacher distillation with reinforcement learning using an SMT solver to compute rewards from numerical thresholds stated in financial rules. We evaluate FormaFin on corporate loan monitoring, in which lenders check borrowers' financial figures against loan agreements. To evaluate our framework, we curate \bench{}, a benchmark containing 143 loan agreements and 2,527 questions covering compliance, earnings cushion, and debt capacity. Our results show that a 7B formalizer achieves 94.8\% accuracy, outperforming open LLMs up to ten times larger. Across three model families, accuracy ranges from 92.6 to 96.8\%. Our framework also detects 95.6 to 99.7\% of errors in other LLMs' financial analyses. We make FormaFin and \bench{} publicly available.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FormaFin，用教师蒸馏加 SMT 求解器计算奖励的强化学习，训练小型开放模型把自然语言金融规则转写为可复用的 SMT 公式，并构建贷款合规基准来验证 LLM 生成的财务分析、检测其中的错误。
AI.relevance_reason: 以外部求解器给出可验证奖励、并用形式化规格反查其他模型推理错误，可能为 LVR 中轨迹监督与「答案是否真正使用中间状态」的核查提供线索；但该工作是纯文本金融合规，不含视觉或 latent 推理状态，需较多核查。
